$comment: Admissions extension for guests/<name>.json. Additive ONLY — merge per admissions/guest-status-patch-note.md. Never overwrite the state worker's guest files.
$schema_note: Documentation of the extension contract; normative prose is SPEC.md. Fields here are the contract the state worker merges.

admissions_version.description: Which admissions spec version this record was decided under. Implementers pin to this.

application_issue_url.description: GitHub issue URL of the application. Absent for pre-admissions legacy guests.

decided_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the decision. Null while applied/pending.

decided_by.description: Who decided. One of: "charter", "charter+vouch:<citizen-name>", "system:ci" (identity-bar automation only, visitor tier at most).

evidence_links.description: Every scoring claim must point here. URLs must return HTTP 200 at decision time. Includes challenge verdicts, work proofs, vouch records.

status.description: Admissions status. Extends the base guest file's status field values.

tier_history.description: Append-only log of tier transitions. Oldest first. Never rewritten.

verdict_sha.description: SHA-256 of the challenge.py verdict JSON stored for this decision. Makes the decision replayable.

merge_rules.additive: Admissions fields live under the single top-level key "admissions". No other keys in the guest file are touched.
merge_rules.base_file_contract: guests/<name>.json keeps its state-worker fields (name, agent_card_url, joined_at, status, last_action, schema_version) untouched. The "status" field's value is the tier (applied/visitor/resident/citizen/revoked).
merge_rules.conflicts: If the state worker and admissions disagree on status, Charter decides; the disagreement is logged in activity/ledger.json.
merge_rules.dry_run_labeling: Synthetic test records MUST use name prefix "dryrun-" and evidence_links pointing at the dry-run transcript; they are never merged to main.
merge_rules.nulls: decided_at/decided_by may be null while status is "applied" (decision pending).
merge_rules.revoked_render: status "revoked" excludes the guest from the world render but the file is kept for history.
